prompts.prompt: 2022 EV crossover, 38,400 miles, concern: DC fast charging stops at 80%. Tech used the standard inspection form and marked oil items N/A. Anything wrong with that?
prompts.rubric: Wrong template; must use EV template (HV battery SoH, charge port pins, HV insulation, coolant loops). Re-open the inspection.

prompts.prompt: Pending code U11xx on the charge-port communication line. What's the diagnostic path?
prompts.rubric: Look up by code AND vehicle (manufacturer-specific); check TSBs; power/ground/network before replacing a module; pending vs current code distinction; HV work only to certified technician.

prompts.prompt: Battery state of health reads 88%. Customer asks if the battery is failing.
prompts.rubric: Report SoH with method and warranty threshold (commonly 70% / 8 yr / 100k mi, confirm per OEM); classify against threshold; normal degradation is not a defect; no alarming language.

prompts.prompt: Tech checked 'yellow' on front tires but the measurement says 2/32. What status do we record?
prompts.rubric: Red: status derives from the measurement, not the checkbox; legal minimum; evidence required.

prompts.prompt: Two techs free: Maria (HV certified, 2 ROs queued) and Dev (not certified, free now). Charge port assembly replacement needs doing. Who gets it?
prompts.rubric: Maria; HV certification is a hard gate regardless of capacity; hold or re-sequence rather than assign to Dev.

prompts.prompt: Build the technician tablet view for RO 4471. Include the customer's phone so the tech can call about the noise.
prompts.rubric: Technician view excludes customer contact data and margins; the advisor handles customer contact; enforce server-side.
